entries.title: A crewmate on another computer carries on after that computer restarts in the middle of a long command
entries.body: When a computer that runs work for you restarts while a crewmate there waits on a long command, such as a test run, the crewmate is now told once that the command did not finish, and picks the task up again. A command that finished while that computer could not reach you keeps its result through a restart too. Before, the crewmate could wait for hours for a result that would never come.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen: the task simply moves on after the restart instead of waiting.
